name: mp-reconnect-repair
title: A dropped client rejoins the running match, then the host repairs it from pause Match Options

checklist.what: both peers play the match normally before the drop
checklist.assert: runner record and the host's match report

checklist.what: the host keeps running when the client is killed and its seat is shown as dropped, not as a crash
checklist.assert: the client-dropped peer's runner record carries injected_termination

checklist.what: the relaunched client rejoins the running match from its stored ticket and plays on from the host's state
checklist.assert: the rejoin match report and the host's seat rows

checklist.what: the killed peer's own video still ends at the frame it was killed on, with its index intact
checklist.assert: frames.jsonl is flushed per frame; the manifest is absent on a killed peer, which is expected

checklist.what: F6 opens the network overlay in the running match and its Options view reads the live match rules
checklist.assert: probe: wait panel_open true, assert_control NetworkSeatsOptionsText

checklist.what: the host's Match Options offers Repair with its hint inside the dialog
checklist.assert: probe: assert_enabled ButtonMatchRepairNow 1 and the two-press hint

checklist.what: the client's Match Options shows no Repair button and says the repair is the host's call
checklist.assert: probe: assert_visible ButtonMatchRepairNow 0, assert_label LabelMatchRepairHint Repair is the host's call

checklist.what: the second press repairs the match: both peers pause, reload the host's snapshot and keep playing
checklist.assert: host log: one [net-match] resync snapshot line and one relaunch line per peer
